qa_pairs.question: Which environment variables are displayed in the initial section of the Abaqus standard analysis temporary directory restart script?
qa_pairs.answer: The script displays the values of `LM_LICENSE_FILE`, `ABAQUSLM_LICENSE_FILE`, `SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR`, and `SLURM_TMPDIR`.

qa_pairs.question: What file system operations are performed at the start of the Abaqus standard analysis temporary directory restart script?
qa_pairs.answer: At the start, the script removes any files matching `testst2*` and `testst1.lck`. It then copies all files matching `testst1*` to the `$SLURM_TMPDIR` and creates a `scratch` subdirectory within `$SLURM_TMPDIR`.
